items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I said you have never seen her... I said I want you to arrange me a nice little arrangement... and he said what do you want to take a number like that buddy and cut it up like I said will you arrange this with a small arrangement

ctx.x: for this five, this trumpet player that I had then with me was Ray, Ray, Ray, Ray, Ray. It's Raymond and Ray. We called him Shorty Mack.
